units.text: INT. OBSERVATORY LIBRARY - NIGHT
A circular room of dark shelves beneath a copper dome, the great telescope shrouded in canvas.
A single oil lamp burns.
Rain beats on the dome like fingers.
INSPECTOR HESTER VANDERMEER, fifties, stands at the reading table with her gloves still on.
DR. LEOPOLD AUGUSTIN, seventies, the astronomer, sits in a leather chair wrapped in a plaid blanket.
His assistant, MISS CLEMENTINE OYELOWO, twenties, stands behind the chair, one hand gripping its back.
Dr. Augustin, you told the constable that you were alone in this room from nine until midnight.
units.name: HESTER

units.text: I was.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: And Miss Oyelowo was at the cottage.
units.name: HESTER

units.text: I was.
units.name: CLEMENTINE

units.text: Then who lit the second lamp?
units.name: HESTER

units.text: I beg your pardon?
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: When the constable arrived, there were two lamps burning in this room. Now there is one.
units.name: HESTER

units.text: I am an old man, Inspector. I may have forgotten.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: You forgot that you'd lit two lamps?
units.name: HESTER

units.text: I forgot nothing. I only remember differently.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: Sir.
units.name: CLEMENTINE

units.text: Hush, Clementine.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: Miss Oyelowo, if you have something to say, now is a very good time.
units.name: HESTER

units.text: I don't.
units.name: CLEMENTINE

units.text: Dr. Augustin, the telescope has been moved.
units.name: HESTER

units.text: It rotates. That is its purpose.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: It has been moved toward the east window, Doctor. And the canvas was warm to the touch when I arrived.
units.name: HESTER

units.text: Warm?
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: As though someone had just been standing beneath it.
units.name: HESTER

units.text: Leopold lifts his chin.
Clementine's grip tightens.
Inspector, it was me.
units.name: CLEMENTINE

units.text: Clementine.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: It was me, Dr. Augustin. I'm sorry.
units.name: CLEMENTINE

units.text: Miss Oyelowo, you told me you were at the cottage.
units.name: HESTER

units.text: I lied.
units.name: CLEMENTINE

units.text: Why?
units.name: HESTER

units.text: Because he told me to.
units.name: CLEMENTINE
